subject: [PATCH 38/60] mm/page_alloc: refuse contiguous allocation from private memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch introduces a check for private memory nodes and returns an error (-EPERM) if exact-PFN contiguous allocation is attempted. This prevents bypassing zonelists and invoking compaction and reclaim.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to improve the handling of contiguous memory allocations in the Linux kernel, specifically for private memory nodes. The goal is to prevent exact-PFN contiguous allocation from bypassing zonelists and invoking compaction and reclaim. To achieve this, the patch introduces a check for private memory nodes and returns an error (-EPERM) if such an allocation attempt is made.
